bstocks-seed.note: Jumper misses listings; seed includes every bStocks mint in bnb.json assets[] on 2026-10-08 through 2026-10-10, including BNCB

fourmeme.note: static 4Stock seed; docs do not publish contracts

snapshot-seen.note: union of every mint stored in bnb.json assets[]; issuer and lane kept

records.method: BNB chainId 56 only; classify ETF/index before private; private admits Colb, Paimon, or registry kind preipo|private with a private-company signal; crypto, commodities, generic baskets, copycats, leveraged/inverse, perps, fan tokens, treasuries, and Paimon Prime stay out; public equity, pre-IPO, and ETF for every issuer; SpaceX (SPCX) is public equity since the 2026-06-12 Nasdaq listing; Colb and Paimon wrappers stay private; closed day prefers GeckoTerminal hourly candles and falls back to DexScreener all-pools h24; each pool is counted once on the base desk token; known pools missing from token-pairs are refetched; GeckoTerminal token pools add PancakeSwap Infinity and Uniswap v4 addresses DexScreener lacks; a token down more than 90% while its main pool still has volume is warned and kept; issuersByLane is that sum partitioned by issuer inside equity, etf, and private; assets[] includes poolCount; null means no reported volume (not zero)

sources.universe: BNB chainId 56 equity/pre-IPO/ETF union by contract address
